The '''''Scatalpen''''' was the [[podracer]] of the [[Aleena]] [[pilot]] [[Ratts Tyerell]]. Equipped with twin [[Vokoff-Strood]] [[Titan 2150 rocket engine]]s, it was named for a deadly [[Scatalpen|predator]] from Tyerell's [[homeworld]],<ref name="CV" /> [[Aleen]].<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> Tyerell used the vehicle in the [[Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing|race]]<ref name="CV" /> of [[32 BBY]]<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. The ''Scatalpen'' was destroyed during the race when the Aleena [[Death|fatally]] crashed<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> in the [[Laguna Caves]].<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Scatalpen'' first appeared in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" /> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the vehicle was first identified in the [[2018]] reference book [[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2018)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'']].<ref name="CV 2018">[[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2018)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'' (2018)]]</ref>
